input.text:
brakence is at 823.5K Spotify monthly listeners, about 89% of his archived peak, with no album since 2022. His new one, marroW, is out Oct 23 (per albumoftheyear.org). 💿

The alt-pop / hyperpop-rap artist broke through with 2022's hypochondriac. Stereogum called the Sep 25, 2026 single "ready or noT" his first new music since, with a video directed and edited by quadeca. "crystallized" and "death rolL" followed in early October.

We checked Wayback Machine snapshots of his Spotify page: 22.7K monthly listeners in Jan 2019, 375.6K in Apr 2020, 789.4K in Mar 2021 and 925K in Feb 2022. As of Oct 15, 2026 he sits at 823.5K. No song passes 32M streams ("fuckboy" leads at 31.9M, then "dropout" with blackbear at 27.9M and "deepfake" at 27.7M), but the catalog adds up to 445M streams across 39 tracks, per kworb.

That's what a cult favorite looks like in data: no giant hit, a very loyal base. Archive snapshots are sparse, so the true peak may have been higher.

Will marroW pull him back past 1M listeners? 👇

Data: Spotify monthly listeners, Wayback Machine snapshots, kworb Spotify streams, albumoftheyear.org · as of Oct 15, 2026
